svg.title: Museu Vivo
svg.desc: Ilustração original do desafio Museu Vivo.
svg.metadata: {"generator": "image_gen built-in", "prompt": "Use case: illustration-story. Use the attached illustration ONLY as the shared STYLE and CHARACTER REFERENCE: premium detailed pixel art, crisp small pixels, subtle dithering, dimensional light, richly layered cozy Brazilian town adventure art. Retain the SAME Black teenage heroine with dark brown skin, voluminous short curly afro hair, lavender purple jacket, cream shirt, navy trousers and white-soled sneakers. Create ONE wholly NEW finished VOICES game-selection cover depicting the described different challenge; replace the entire scene and character pose. Wide 20:9 landscape (approximately 1870x841), edge-to-edge key art for a 640x288 card. Clear readable action at thumbnail size; main subjects within the central 75 percent height. No lettering, text, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, interface, HUD, borders, screenshot look, photorealism, toy 3D or smooth vector illustration. Challenge: Museu Vivo, a Sokoban-style restoration puzzle. An inviting museum gallery viewed from an elevated three-quarter angle with its foreground wall removed. The heroine leans forward and PUSHES a waist-high square wooden and glass display case toward a clearly visible turquoise and brass DIAMOND-shaped floor marker one tile ahead. Show a second matching display case already centered on another softly glowing diamond floor marker. The cases contain tasteful small cultural artifacts such as a handmade ceramic vessel and a book, not treasures or weapons. Beautiful cream stone floor with a readable square tile pattern, sage and warm ochre walls, framed paintings, carved wooden benches, arched windows and trailing plants. Warm late afternoon shafts of light and soft reflections on glass. The pushing action and target positions are the main clear focal points. Thoughtful movement puzzle, warm community museum rather than a grand temple. No letters, arrows or instruction signs."}
